newsitem.title: CHINA: China to focus on 19 coal projects in 1997.
newsitem.headline: China to focus on 19 coal projects in 1997.

text.p: China will focus its attention on 19 key projects in the coal industry this year, the Xinhua news agency said on Wednesday, quoting a notice from the State Planning Commission.

Four major coal projects will be built in northern Shanxi province, two in the Inner Mongolia region, two in northeastern Heilongjiang province, two in central Anhui province, two in eastern Shandong province, three in central Henan province, one in northwestern Ningxia, one in central Shaanxi Province, one in northern Hebei Province and the one in northwest Gansu.
The report gave no details of the projects.
